title: Dashboard
purpose: A 30-second read before you pick up the phone.
question: What are rates doing right now?
how_to_read: Pressure meter first, then the driver panel. If the top driver is OBSERVED you can trust the direction. If everything is INFERRED, the market has not actually moved today.

sources.name: Freddie Mac
sources.caveat: THIS IS A SURVEY AVERAGE, not a rate sheet. It covers Thursday through Wednesday, is conventional / conforming / 80% LTV / strong credit, and assumes about 0.6 points paid. It will always look calmer and later than your lender pricing. Never quote it as a borrower rate.

sources.name: MRIT derived
sources.caveat: Anything stamped MODELED is a construction, not an observation.

sources.name: U.S. Department of the Treasury
sources.caveat: Par yields derived from the on-the-run bid side at roughly 3:30 pm ET. Not intraday. A big afternoon move lands in tomorrow’s print.
